question: Mawsynram, the place that receives the highest rainfall in the world, is situated in which hills?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khasi Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mawsynram**, situated in the **East Khasi Hills **district of **Meghalaya,** India, is renowned as the wettest place on Earth.
 
• It is nestled on the southern slopes of the Khasi Hills, surrounded by hills on three sides.
 
• This region experiences a subtropical highland climate, characterized by a lengthy monsoon season and a brief dry season.
 
• Mawsynram boasts an average annual rainfall of 11,872 millimeters, making it a unique climatic phenomenon.
 
• In 1985, Mawsynram achieved a remarkable milestone by recording 26,000 millimeters of rainfall, as documented in the Guinness Book of World Records.
 
• Recently, on June 17, 2022, Mawsynram surpassed its own record by receiving an astounding 1,003.6 millimeters of rainfall in just 24 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Khasi Hills,** situated in India's Meghalaya state, form a modest mountain range within the Garo-Khasi-Jaintia range. These hills are encompassed by the Meghalaya subtropical forests ecoregion.
 
• **The Patkai Hills,** alternatively referred to as the Eastern Mountain Range, constitute a chain of mountains straddling the border between India and Myanmar.
 
• **The Mishmi Hills**, an extension of the Himalayas, stretch southward in northeastern Arunachal Pradesh, India.
 
• **The Rajmahal Hills** are positioned within the Santhal Pargana division of Jharkhand, India.
